what: Clicking a link to another page on the same site makes five vertical background-color strips rise from the bottom (.38s power3.inOut), covering the screen with a delay of .05s each outward from the strip at the pressed spot (the screen divided into five columns), and .2s later the center mark (logo) stands up from .86× and transparent at .3s power2.out before navigating. On the arriving page the mark disappears in .18s power2.in and .06s later the strips lift upward from the left with .05s delays (.46s power3.inOut)

options.[data-fx-part=col]: Vertical bands (children, several) — original has five
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: (If any) badge (logo) that stands in the center after covering
options.in · out: Cover · uncover durations (s), default .38 · .46 — shorten for screens that change often
options.[data-no-wipe]: Links inside this go straight through without a transition
